findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so uploaded report data is not explicitly protected with S3-managed or KMS encryption at rest.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving ledger exports without an explicit encryption-at-rest requirement.

The bucket lacks a default server-side encryption configuration, leaving potentially sensitive operational documentation without an explicit encryption-at-rest control.
